interview.name: Leo
interview.answer: The repair drive details haven’t been specified yet.

reflections: Leo is a dependable volunteer who responds quickly and takes on concrete tasks.
Mara delegates clearly and appreciatively, which helps coordinate support effectively.
Uli wants to help but needs discretion, and Leo adjusts to that constraint with care.
Leo is consistently helpful and reliable, especially when others ask for practical support.
The group responds well to Leo’s calm, low-key coordination style and values clear follow-up details.
Uli needs discretion, and Leo adapts to that need by offering quiet support without pressure.
Leo is the main organizer and point of contact, keeping plans low-key and providing details as they become available.
The others are supportive and flexible, offering to help with setup, spreading the word, and bringing items once timing and needs are confirmed.
There is a shared preference for simple, coordinated coordination with people waiting on final logistics before acting.
Leo is the central organizer, coordinating logistics and keeping the event low-key and straightforward.
Ira is supportive but still waiting on the full plan before committing to action.
Vik and Eli are cooperative helpers who respond well to clear details and timing.
Leo is a reliable coordinator who handles logistics and keeps the group informed.
Vik and Tess are proactive supporters who help spread the word and contribute items.
Eli values clear, ordered planning and helps keep the schedule and details organized.
